lunch.name: Jollof Rice (West African Spiced Rice)
lunch.description: Iconic West African lunch - spiced rice with tomato base. Different countries compete over who makes best version
instructions: Blend tomatoes, onion, garlic and bell pepper
Heat oil, fry blended mixture and tomato paste for 10 minutes until oil rises
Add ginger, thyme, bay leaf, cook 2 minutes
Rinse rice, add to pot, stir to coat with tomato mixture
Add broth, bring to boil
Reduce heat to low, cover, cook 20-25 minutes until rice is tender
Remove bay leaf, season with salt and pepper
lunch.notes: Oil must rise to top after frying for best flavor. Rice should be separate grains, not mushy
lunch.fun_fact: Jollof Rice is iconic West African dish, different countries compete over who makes best version. Popular lunch everywhere

dinner.name: Nigerian Jollof Rice (West African Spiced Red Rice)
dinner.description: West African spiced red rice - pan-West African dinner classic
ingredients: 2 Maggi cubes or chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: Blend red peppers, Scotch bonnets, fresh tomatoes, 1 onion, garlic, ginger into puree
Heat oil in large pot over medium heat
Dice remaining onion; fry until soft (3-4 minutes)
Add blended pepper mixture; cook 20-30 minutes until sauce thickens and turns brick-red
Oil should separate at edges
Break crumbled Maggi cubes into mixture
Add canned tomatoes; cook 5 minutes
Add paprika; stir well
Rinse rice thoroughly in warm water; drain well
Add rice to pot; stir to coat with sauce (2-3 minutes)
Add broth and bay leaves; stir once
Bring to boil; reduce heat to low, cover tightly
Cook 20-25 minutes until rice fluffy and liquid absorbed
Do not stir after liquid added
Taste and adjust salt and pepper
Garnish with fresh parsley
dinner.notes: Sauce must cook until deeply brick-red color
dinner.fun_fact: Pan-West African with regional variations between countries
